messages:
maria: Kicking off bring-up for eu-central-gpu-1 (4x A100). Before SRE takes it, we need a short security baseline: IAM roles, secrets, KMS/HSM integration, and policy checks. Who can own?
jamal: I can own IAM mappings + RBAC. Will draft role names and least-priv rules.
anya: I'll take secrets + KMS integration. We'll use the corporate HSM-backed key for root envelopes.
lee: I'll run the networking and policy scans (NSGs, egress controls). Also will validate VPC endpoints for KMS.
sec-bot: Reminder: required rotation policy for any cluster secrets is 30 days; vault path must be under secret/redwood/clusters/eu-central-gpu-1.
maria: Good. High-level checklist I want in the thread (short): 1) IAM roles & service accounts 2) Secrets in Vault + rotation 3) KMS key policy & HSM binding 4) Network egress/ingress policy 5) Audit logging + KMS logs 6) Policy-as-code scan results
jamal: Proposed IAM roles: cluster-admin-lite (no billing perms), node-provisioner (attach ENIs, describe instances), inference-runtime (read models from S3 read-only + kms:Decrypt), metrics-ingest (write to timeseries). Will post binding snippet.
jamal: ```yaml
# example iam bindings
- role: roles/inference.runtime
  members:
    - serviceAccount:inference@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  conditions: []
```
anya: KMS: we'll create key alias alias/redwood-eu-gpu-1 and set key policy to allow Decrypt for the inference-runtime role, Admins (sec-admins) and the HSM service principal. Enable key rotation (yearly) and require HSM wrapping. Also ensure CMEK support for any bucket containing models.
anya: Vault: path secret/redwood/clusters/eu-central-gpu-1/*, ACLs: only node-provisioner & inference-runtime can read runtime secrets, ops can read for emergency. Enable KV v2 and automatic rotation hooks.
lee: Networking: mandatory egress deny-list for known bad IP ranges, only allow egress to packager repos and artifact stores. KMS endpoints must be over VPC endpoints. Add egress metric alerts if outbound > 1Mbps per node.
sec-bot: Actionable checks added to ticket INFRA-4321. Required: terraform plan must include iam bindings, vault policies, kms resources, and a policy-scan pass.
maria: Can we add a small policy-as-code gating rule: deny terraform apply unless policy-scan exit code 0 and kms key has hsm_binding=true tag?\amjamal: yes — we have an OPA gate in our pipeline. I'll add a rule: `deny if kms.hsm_binding != true` and `deny if iam.role has wildcard_permissions`.
anya: Quick validation steps before handoff: 1) IAM smoke: run minimal token exchange, 2) Vault read test from node-provisioner SA, 3) KMS encrypt/decrypt roundtrip, 4) Policy scan pass, 5) Audit log presence in audit-logs bucket.
lee: I'll run network validation and share tcpdump snippets if anything odd.
maria: Timeline: get IAM + KMS done by EOD today, secrets + Vault tomorrow morning, policy-scan by noon. Handoff to SRE once all green.
jamal: Assigning: IAM -> jamal, KMS+Vault -> anya, Network+scan -> lee. I'll open a PR with bindings and the OPA rule.
infra-bot: Provisioning task completed: 4 GPUs attached to eu-central-gpu-1. Instance IDs: i-0a1b2c3d, i-0d3c2b1a.
anya: After infra-bot confirm, I did a KMS decrypt test with the inference-runtime SA and it succeeded. Posting logs.
anya: ```json
{"kms_decrypt": "OK", "timestamp": 1769456830}
```
jamal: IAM smoke test succeeded: token exchange + sts:AssumeRole worked for inference-runtime.
lee: Policy-scan results: 3 warnings (unused roles), 0 denies. I'll prune in the PR.
maria: Great progress. Once PR merged and policy scan passes, I'll move to SRE handoff and add the cluster to the fleet inventory. Add any outstanding TODOs to INFRA-4321. :thumbsup:
